cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave before I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?
